correctness.rationale: Exact 18-vertex GP(9,2) edge definition and all 2461 independent faces were reconstructed. The augmented acyclic Hasse-poset matching has 1230 pairs and one critical five-face, giving a Morse CW complex with a point and one 5-cell. Two exhaustive deletion matchings on 1878 and 1874 faces are acyclic and independently yield 938 and 936 actual elementary simplicial collapses. Rotational symmetry covers all 18 deletions. Direct signed fixed-simplex traces for the rotation and reflection give reduced Lefschetz values -1 and 1, proving respective integral H5 actions +1 and -1; every group element is checked.

value.rationale: GP(9,2) is a classical cubic generalized Petersen graph with a studied exact independence number. The eighteen-vertex support-essentiality of the unique integral sphere class is a sharp global homological statement: every graph vertex is indispensable despite the independence complex being six-dimensional. Actual simplicial collapses for both vertex-orbit deletions and the contrasting dihedral orientation character give independent geometric structure not recoverable from the known alpha=7 table or general suspension theorem.
